criteria_checklist.quote: MRI of Lumbar Spine (dated 2026-10-14) reveals Grade II anterolisthesis of L4 on L5 with severe secondary canal stenosis and bilateral neuroforaminal impingement.

criteria_checklist.quote: Trial of Meloxicam 15mg daily and 2 fluoroscopically-guided transforaminal epidural steroid injections provided only transient relief (<10 days each).

criteria_checklist.rule: Dynamic weight-bearing flexion and extension plain radiographs within 90 days demonstrating segmental instability
criteria_checklist.action_needed: Dynamic standing X-rays on file are 11 months old. Recommend clinic physician orders updated lumbar flexion/extension series before submission.

appeal_letter.body_markdown:
### CLINICAL NECESSITY SUBSTANTIATION & RECONSIDERATION REQUEST

**To the Medical Review Board:**

This is a formal first-level appeal regarding the prior authorization denial for **Sarah Jenkins** for CPT code **22612** (Arthrodesis, posterior or posterolateral technique, single interspace; lumbar).

The denial dated November 18, 2026 cited: *"Clinical documentation submitted fails to satisfy prerequisite criteria outlined in Clinical Policy Bulletin #0016 regarding conservative therapy and segmental instability."*

Upon comprehensive clinical re-audit of the patient encounter and diagnostic imaging records, we respectfully submit that the patient fully meets Aetna's published medical necessity criteria:

1. **Supervised Conservative Therapy (Met)**: Patient completed 8 weeks of supervised physical therapy focusing on core stabilization from August to October 2026 with documented treatment failure [Doc: Clinic_Note_2026-10-20.pdf, Page 2, Line 18].
2. **High-Resolution Diagnostic Grounding (Met)**: Lumbar MRI confirms Grade II anterolisthesis of L4 on L5 with severe canal stenosis [Doc: MRI_Report_2026-10-14.pdf, Page 1, Line 12].
3. **Failure of Interventional Pain Management (Met)**: Documented failure of Meloxicam and two fluoroscopically-guided transforaminal ESIs [Doc: Clinic_Note_2026-10-20.pdf, Page 3, Line 8].

We request an immediate overturn of this denial. Please find attached the corroborating clinical records with line-item citations.

Sincerely,

**Dr. Robert Vance, MD**  
Department of Orthopedic Spine Surgery  
NPI: 1982736451
